On the week-blocked primary reference (within-week game correlation is zero by owner mandate) the CI upper bound is POSITIVE (+0.135), so the interval is not resolved entirely below zero and refuted_mechanism is unavailable. The season-blocked secondary CI [-1.195,-0.800] does sit wholly below zero, but with only 3 season blocks it has almost no combinatorial diversity and is a low-power artifact of block count, not a resolution -- and it is a secondary read at a grade that may not close anything. Recorded unresolved_below_power.

graph_off_rush_epa_on_production.notes:
Paired candidate(weak_stack_graph_off_rush_epa)-minus-baseline(weak_stack) on 749 games, 51 weeks, close-graded 2014-2016 (rotation family graph_off_rush_epa_on_production, inherits graph_ratings_v2_team_stat; ASSIGNED the [2014,2016] block by nfl-ats rotation assign, never hand-picked -- the same block both sibling families drew, since a sibling's spent window is invisible to this family's own touched-season computation, disclosed in docs/graph_team_stat_off_rush_epa_on_production.md section 5). Candidate accuracy 50.07% vs baseline 51.00%. Week-blocked 95% CI [-1.998,+0.135] pts, P+ 0.037; season-blocked 95% CI [-1.195,-0.800], P+ 0.000 (degenerate, only 3 season blocks). Home-pick rate baseline 37.63% vs candidate 36.72% (close together, so little home-tilt artifact here). Within-week permutation null (200 perms, real feature) centres at +0.196 pts, sd 0.512; observed -0.935 sits at the 0.5th percentile of its own null -- the deepest negative-tail placement of the three siblings (off_sack_rate 6.0th, def_ypp 8.0th), though with 200 draws, three uncorrected families and no multiplicity correction, one tail placement is not itself a finding. Positive control (candidate column replaced by realized ats_margin) showed +48.999 pts, P+ 1.000, week 95% CI [+45.661,+51.921], proving the full-profile ridge harness is not blind. The paired delta is numerically identical to the off_sack_rate sibling's (-7 of 749 games) -- same window, same discrete grid, coincidence on the accuracy grid, not a shared computation. NOT commensurable with graph_ratings_v2_team_stat (bare-baseline comparator), graph_input_screen (single-feature vs zero-feature market baseline), graph_off_sack_rate_on_production or graph_def_ypp_on_production (different candidate families): the comparator here is the FULL PRODUCTION CHAIN, so this entry is NOT poolable with graph_ratings_v2_team_stat and is recorded under its own family per AGENTS.md's pooling-commensurability rule. CLOSE-graded: settles no play/no-play decision. Predeclared in docs/graph_team_stat_off_rush_epa_on_production.md before any outcome was scored, including the explicit prior that the screen doc calls this cell's apparent edge 'essentially all artifact'.
